Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands in front of his patient, Jack, a disheveled young man with a wild look in his eye 🤪. Jack sits on the edge of his bed, his arms crossed and a defiant glint in his eye 💪.

DR. SMITH:
Jack, it's time for your medication. You know it's good for you 📦.

JACK:
I don't want it! I don't need it! It's just a bunch of chemicals to control my mind 💥.

DR. SMITH:
(sighing) Jack, you know the risks. You know it's the only way to manage your symptoms 🤕.

JACK:
I refuse! I won't take it! (stands up and starts to walk away) You can't make me! I'm not a child! 🚫

DR. SMITH:
(frustrated) Fine, have it your way. (tries to grab Jack's arm, but Jack dodges and weaves, avoiding his grasp) Ah, come on, Jack! Just take the pills! 🤦‍♂️

JACK:
(laughing maniacally) You'll take them for me! You'll prove they're safe! (starts to chant) Take the pills, take the pills, take the pills! 🎤

Dr. Smith, feeling a sense of unease, hesitates for a moment before reluctantly complying 🤔. He opens his mouth, and Jack's voice echoes in his mind, "Take the pills, take the pills, take the pills!" 💥

Dr. Smith swallows the pills, and suddenly, Jack is gone 🤯. The room is empty, except for Dr. Smith, who looks around in confusion 🤔.

DR. SMITH:
(whispering to himself) Where did he go? 🤔

As he looks down at his hands, he notices that they're shaking and his eyes are wild with a manic energy 😱. He looks up, and his eyes lock onto a figure standing in the corner of the room 👀.

JACK:
(smiling) You see, Doc? I'm not just a figment of your imagination. I'm the real deal! 🎩

Dr. Smith's eyes widen in shock as he realizes the truth: he's the one who's been delusional all along 🤯. The pills were just a placebo, and he's been living in a world of his own making 🌐.

FADE TO BLACK 🎬
